verdict.recommendation: KEEP for diversifier pool but do NOT promote. OOS decay from 0.977 to 0.557 suggests ICIR weighting may be capturing noise. The aggressive DD 5/15 mutation (M3) reduced MDD from base ~35% to 24.76% but at cost of CAGR. Consider: (1) relaxing DD parameters to recover CAGR, (2) testing with fewer factors to reduce dimensionality, (3) increasing MIN_IC_MONTHS from 12 to 24 for more stable ICIR. PIT compliance is exemplary -- 2-month IC lag is conservative and correct.
